tools.name: ledger_summary
tools.title: What am I owed
tools.description: Total what this household has recovered from broken promises and what is still open. Answers 'what am I owed?'

tools.name: promises_list
tools.title: List promises
tools.description: List the promises made to this household, optionally narrowed to a status or a merchant. Answers 'what is Owed watching?' and 'what has Northwind promised me?'

tools.name: promise_check
tools.title: Check a promise
tools.description: Explain what Owed concluded about one promise and why — the coverage, the evidence, and the stretches nobody was watching. Answers 'why?' and 'why aren't you claiming that?'

tools.name: evidence_get
tools.title: Get one piece of evidence
tools.description: Retrieve a single piece of evidence and the promise it belongs to.

tools.name: claim_status
tools.title: Check a claim
tools.description: Show where a claim has got to — what was asked, what was offered, what was countered and what was settled. Answers 'what happened with that claim?'

tools.name: claim_file
tools.title: File a claim
tools.description: File a claim for a broken promise and settle it with the merchant's agent. Answers 'file it', 'claim that' and 'go ahead'. Needs the household's confirmation first.

confirm.description: The household's yes. Nothing is filed without it.

attach_evidence.description: Send the supporting evidence with the claim. Defaults to true.
